name: show_places
description: Show places (restaurants, cafés, shops, sights) as cards the person can compare and pick from: each its photo, name, rating and reviews, price, kind, distance, whether it is open and its hours, with a link to its map and its phone when given. Use it whenever you offer the person a few places to choose between, in the order you recommend them. Give what you know of each: the chat adds its rating, reviews, price, open-now and today's hours from Google after you send it, so never write 0 or empty for them nor say they are unchecked; asked about them later, read them with a place-details tool. Only shows them; there is no reply: the person picks one by saying so, as a message.

from.description: Where the person is, when they shared it (ask_location): the map shows them beside the places

address.description: Its full address, with its town and country, e.g. 53a Old Theatre Street, Valletta, Malta

distance.description: How far it is from where the person is or asked about, e.g. 0.4 km

hours.description: Its hours in a few words, e.g. till 22:30, or opens 19:00

kind.description: What kind of place it is, e.g. Maltese, Italian, Café

mapsUrl.description: Its page on a map: an https link, e.g. Google Maps

photo.description: A photo of it: an https link to an image

price.description: Its price level as € signs, e.g. €€

reviews.description: How many reviews the rating is from

title.description: What the places are, e.g. Restaurants near Valletta
